name: porcupine
description: North American porcupine, side view facing right: round low dark brown-black body, the back and club tail covered in long bristling quills with dark bases and cream #e8dcc0 tips sweeping backwards, blunt dark face with a black nose and small dark eye (not cute), short legs with dark claws. Spiky dome silhouette reads upright or rotated 180. Anchor bottom-centre (feet on y=0), ~420x260 (x -240..206, y -270..0).
